information.description:
Militech still denies that killer borg ninjas exist, and the Nemesis is the one it denies hardest. It keeps the old Eclipse's chameleon skin and adds sensors that keep it moving when an ambush goes wrong. Officially, this entry is a misprint.

Cost: 25,700eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 70 (21d6)
Frame: Beta (14): BODY 14
Eyes: MonoVision
Chrome: Amplified Hearing, Atomic Sensors, FBC Chameleon Coating ×3, Grip Foot ×2, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Low Light/Infrared/UV, Popup Melee Weapon, Radio Communicator, Scrambler/Descrambler, Subdermal Armor, Subdermal Pocket ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
